meta.name: Monster of the Week
meta.notes: Seat limits are decision D3 (3.16). Rules: the first draft (Appendix G) as amended in section 3. Cards: the core deck, the 21 cards here. Numbers: first-draft guesses (G.7), each a variant. Map: the prototype board, layout D (testing only).

slayerGroups.name: AV Club
slayerGroups.trope: Teen hackers and computer club nerds

slayerGroups.name: Father and the Flock
slayerGroups.trope: A parish exorcist and reluctant helpers

cards.name: Invite Them In
cards.text: Two groups of different factions next door are invited into an empty location. Target: where they’re invited.

readings.location: an empty Nocturnal location; any two groups next to it.
readings.faction: a location held by a lone group of another faction, next to a Nocturnal group: only the Nocturnals come.

layout.gist: groups next door into one location
loc: any two groups next to it, of different factions
fac: a location held by a lone group of another faction, next to a Nocturnal group
layout.flavour: The Slayerettes leave the door open and the porch light on. Something always comes in.

cards.name: The Gate
cards.text: Join two locations for the rest of the round: they count as a single location for movement, and fight as one (strength and sway added across both; a true tie scorches both). Never three factions across them. Only 1 sway, at one end: from the Sci-Fi faction if it is at either end, otherwise a faction there. Target: the two ends.

readings.faction: two locations holding the Sci-Fi faction.

layout.gist: two locations, for the rest of the round
specifics: They count as a single location for movement.
They fight as one: strength and sway added across both; a true tie scorches both.
Never three factions across them.
Only 1 sway, at one end: from the Sci-Fi faction if it is at either end, otherwise a faction there.
layout.flavour: The Kids on Bikes find the rift behind the arcade. Whatever goes in comes out somewhere else.

cards.name: Spoof the Signal
cards.text: The AV Club spoofs a command signal to a group: ordered to engage the strongest hostile force in range, it marches on the largest lone group of another faction within two locations of it (ties: your choice). Target: the group fooled.

readings.location: a group at a Sentient location.

layout.gist: the largest lone group of another faction within two locations
specifics: Ties: your choice.
layout.flavour: The AV Club spoofs a command signal to a group: ordered to engage the strongest hostile force in range.

cards.name: Bait the Herd
cards.text: Lay a trail of bait: a group follows it from neighbour to neighbour, picking up its own kind at every stop and leaving nothing behind. It stops where you choose, or crashes into a lone group of another faction. Target: the herd.

readings.location: a group at an Undead location.

layout.gist: a group, from neighbour to neighbour
specifics: It picks up its own kind at every stop and leaves nothing behind.
It stops where you choose, or crashes into a lone group of another faction.
layout.flavour: Lay a trail of bait, and the herd follows it.

cards.name: Perform the Ritual
cards.text: Father and the Flock begin the rite, and one faction next door is drawn to it: every group of it comes, whole if it’s alone, as many as you choose if it’s in a fight. The centre is empty or holds one faction. Target: the centre, then the faction called.

readings.location: a Demon location; any faction is called.
readings.faction: any location next to the Demon faction; the Demons are called.

layout.gist: one faction next door, every group of it, into the centre
layout.target: the centre, then the faction called
fac: any location next to the Demon faction
specifics: Whole if it’s alone; as many as you choose if it’s in a fight.
The centre is empty or holds one faction.
layout.flavour: Father and the Flock begin the rite, and one faction next door is drawn to it.

cards.name: Draw Them Away
cards.text: The Watch sets out distractions all round the location, and one of the dead shambles off to check each. A group sends 1 token to each of at least two neighbours; the rest stay. Target: the group.

readings.location: a group at an Undead location.

layout.gist: 1 token to each of at least two neighbours
specifics: The rest stay.
layout.flavour: The Watch sets out distractions all round the location, and one of the dead shambles off to check each.

cards.name: The Big Chase
cards.text: The Kids on Bikes lead a group on a chase from neighbour to neighbour, across any region, through empty ground, lone rivals, its own kind and fights it’s part of. Every location it passes keeps 1 token; the rest, at least 1, arrive wherever you end it. Target: the group chased.

readings.location: a group at a Sci-Fi location.

layout.gist: a group from neighbour to neighbour; every location it passes keeps 1
specifics: Across any region, through empty ground, lone rivals, its own kind and fights it’s part of.
The rest, at least 1, arrive wherever you end it.
layout.flavour: The Kids on Bikes lead a group on a chase.

cards.name: Cut the Powerlines
cards.text: The AV Club cuts the powerlines. A group scatters to its faction’s other groups anywhere on the island, 1 token at a time: no group gets a second until every group has one. A lone group leaves entirely; from a fight, exactly half. Target: the group.

readings.location: any group at a Sentient location.

layout.gist: a group to its faction’s other groups anywhere, 1 token at a time
specifics: No group gets a second until every group has one.
A lone group leaves entirely; from a fight, exactly half.
layout.flavour: The AV Club cuts the powerlines.

cards.name: Plough Through
cards.text: The Slayerettes plough a truck straight through the middle of the brawl. Every side leaves by half, rounded up, split as you choose among its neighbours, never two sides to the same location. Its sway is paid by the factions in the fight or the Nocturnals, split as you choose. Target: the fight.

readings.location: a fight at a Nocturnal location.
readings.faction: a fight the Nocturnals are in.

layout.gist: every side of a fight, by half, rounded up
specifics: Split as you choose among its neighbours, never two sides to the same location.
Its sway is paid by the factions in the fight or the Nocturnals, split as you choose.
layout.flavour: The Slayerettes plough a truck straight through the middle of the brawl.

cards.name: Light of the Cross
cards.text: The cross is raised and the target group falls back from its light, split evenly between two neighbours. A group of 1 can’t be split. Target: the group.

readings.location: any group at a Demon location.

layout.gist: a group, evenly between two neighbours
specifics: A group of 1 can’t be split.
layout.flavour: The cross is raised and the target group falls back from its light.

cards.name: Wake the Dead
cards.text: The Watch chases the fight into the old cemetery, and the dead rise: as many from the Undead supply as you choose, up to the card’s sway. At an Undead location they rise as a group of their own, and if two factions are already fighting there, as a third side. Each one risen places 1 of your sway there. Target: where they rise.

readings.location: any Undead location; at a fight there, the dead rise as a third side.
readings.faction: any location holding the Undead; the risen join them.

layout.gist: as many as you choose from the Undead supply, up to the card’s sway
loc: as a group of their own; at a fight there, as a third side
specifics: Each one risen places 1 of your sway there.
layout.flavour: The Watch chases the fight into the old cemetery, and the dead rise.

cards.name: Take Control
cards.text: The AV Club takes control of the machines and turns them on the enemy. At the target fight, spend your sway there, 1 for each, to cut down up to the card’s sway of a faction’s tokens there: you take them as trophies, and the sway spent goes back to your supply. Target: the fight, then the faction hit.

readings.location: any fight at a Sentient location; you choose the faction hit.
readings.faction: any fight the Sentients are in; their rival is hit.

layout.gist: up to the card’s sway of a faction’s tokens at a fight, as trophies
layout.target: the fight, then the faction hit
loc: any fight at a Sentient location
fac: any fight the Sentients are in
specifics: Spend your sway there, 1 for each.
The sway spent goes back to your supply.
layout.flavour: The AV Club takes control of the machines and turns them on the enemy.

cards.name: Night Terrors
cards.text: The Slayerettes stir up terrors in the dark. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. When night falls, before the fights, at each mark you may make 1 token of a faction there flee to a neighbouring location it can enter; your sway from the mark may follow it. Target: the locations marked.

layout.gist: up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each
specifics: When night falls, before the fights, at each mark you may make 1 token of a faction there flee to a neighbouring location it can enter.
Your sway from the mark may follow it.
layout.flavour: The Slayerettes stir up terrors in the dark.

cards.name: Study the Bodies
cards.text: The Kids on Bikes sneak in after the fight to study the bodies. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. This round, at a marked location’s fight, if you lead there, you also take 1 trophy from the runner-up’s pile. Target: the locations marked.

layout.gist: up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each
specifics: This round, at a marked location’s fight, if you lead there, you also take 1 trophy from the runner-up’s pile.
layout.flavour: The Kids on Bikes sneak in after the fight to study the bodies.

cards.name: Spill Blood on the Altar
cards.text: Father and the Flock spill blood on the altar. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. This round, at a marked location’s fight, the winner loses as many as the loser. Target: the locations marked.

layout.gist: up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each
specifics: This round, at a marked location’s fight, the winner loses as many as the loser.
layout.flavour: Father and the Flock spill blood on the altar.

cards.name: Call in Favours
cards.text: Choose one. Sway: 1 sway from your supply at each of up to X fights. Standing: up to X standing with one faction, from your supply. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

layout.gist: up to X from your supply

uses.text: 1 sway from your supply at each of up to X fights.
up to X standing with one faction, from your supply.

specifics: X is the cards in your hand, this one included.
layout.flavour: Everyone in this town owes somebody something. Tonight you collect.

cards.name: Raise the Stakes
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: take 1 standing from each of up to X factions, all into one. Sway: gather up to X of your sway from next door into one location. Tokens: up to X tokens of one faction come in from its groups next door, to a location where you have sway. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

layout.gist: up to X into one

uses.text: take 1 standing from each of up to X factions, all into one.
gather up to X of your sway from next door into one location.
up to X tokens of one faction come in from its groups next door, to a location where you have sway.

specifics: X is the cards in your hand, this one included.
layout.flavour: Double or nothing, and nobody walks away.

cards.name: Cover Every Exit
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: move 1 standing from one faction to each of up to X others. Sway: send 1 of your sway from one location to each of up to X neighbours. Tokens: a group sends 1 token to each of up to X neighbours. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

layout.gist: 1 to each of up to X

uses.text: move 1 standing from one faction to each of up to X others.
send 1 of your sway from one location to each of up to X neighbours.
a group sends 1 token to each of up to X neighbours.

specifics: X is the cards in your hand, this one included.
layout.flavour: Every door, every window, every storm drain. Nothing slips out unseen.

cards.name: Showdown
cards.text: At a lone group, never a fight, burn your sway there, 1 for each token, to take that many of its tokens as your trophies. Burned sway goes back to your supply. Target: the group.

layout.gist: a lone group’s tokens, 1 of your sway burned for each
specifics: Never a fight.
You take them as your trophies.
Burned sway goes back to your supply.
layout.flavour: High noon on Main Street. Only one side walks away.

cards.name: Switch Allegiance
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: burn up to X standing with one faction to gain the same with another. Sway: move up to X of your sway from one location to any other. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

layout.gist: up to X from one to another

uses.text: burn up to X standing with one faction to gain the same with another.
move up to X of your sway from one location to any other.

specifics: X is the cards in your hand, this one included.
layout.flavour: Loyalty in this town lasts about as long as the daylight.

cards.name: Steal Their Playbook
cards.text: Choose one. Theirs: take a card another player played this round, however they played it, from the played cards into your hand, and play it now as your own. Yours: take back into your hand a card you played earlier this round. It can't be your last card played: as the last card in your hand it is discarded, for no effect.

layout.gist: a card played this round, into your hand

uses.text: a card another player played this round, however they played it, from the played cards; play it now as your own.
back a card you played earlier this round.

specifics: It can’t be your last card played: as the last card in your hand it is discarded, for no effect.
layout.flavour: Whatever worked for them will work twice as well for us.

variants.label: Presence threshold
variants.description: The invaders win if total presence is more than this (TH1). First-draft guess 20 (G.7). 30 by default (designer, 2026-10-29, D33).

variants.label: Growth threshold
variants.description: A lone faction with at least this many tokens at a location grows (GR1).

choices.label: Off
choices.description: No growth (GR1 and AL3 off); a test of nightfall tokens replacing it (designer, 2026-10-30).

variants.label: Tokens per faction
variants.description: Each faction's tokens, board and supply together (G.7). 30 by default (designer, 2026-10-29, D33).

variants.label: Cubes per player
variants.description: Each player's sway cubes (G.7). 30 while the cards are designed: a bump from 20 so the supply rarely limits play (designer, 2026-10-07); the balancing number comes later.

variants.label: Starting sway
variants.description: Sway each slayer group starts with, with its linked faction (G.7). Designer (2026-10-07): start with more sway on the affinity faction; 5 is Claude’s suggested starting number (was 3), to measure.

variants.label: Starting standing with other factions
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-07): each player starts with 1 sway with every faction other than their affinity faction. 0 was the first draft before. Designer (2026-10-29, D32): 2 by default, a bit more standing with the factions that aren't your suit's. Back to 1 by default (designer, 2026-10-29, D33).

variants.label: Starting sway on affinity locations
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-07): each slayer group starts with 1 sway on the board at each of its affinity locations (its archetype’s three), from its supply.

variants.label: Slayer groups
variants.description: How slayer groups are given out (G.7).

choices.label: Random
choices.description: Each seat draws a slayer group at random.

choices.label: Seat order
choices.description: Seats take slayer groups in spec order.

variants.label: Sway per move
variants.description: Test lever (sway economy, 2026-10-07): sway a move places at each destination, from standing with the faction moved (CA2).

choices.description: The first draft.
Test lever.

variants.label: Growth on own ground
variants.description: AL3: a faction controlling one of its aligned locations grows 1 more there (designer: off 2026-10-21, back on by default 2026-10-24).

choices.label: Off
choices.description: Every growing group grows 1 (designer, 2026-10-21).

choices.label: On
choices.description: AL3 as first drafted: 1 more on its own aligned ground.

variants.label: Sway brings tokens
variants.description: GR5 (designer's seed, 2026-10-29; a switch, not a core rule): each sway placed on the board, from standing with a faction, brings 1 of that faction's tokens from its supply to the same location, if it can (the supply has one, and the faction may enter there). Or one slot's cards only (designer, 2026-10-29): the shifts (scatters), the strikes (gathers) or the signatures. Shifts only by default (designer, 2026-10-29, D33).

choices.label: Off
choices.description: Sway brings no tokens.

choices.label: On
choices.description: Each sway placed brings 1 of its faction's tokens, if it can.

choices.label: Shifts only
choices.description: Only the shifts' sway (the scatters) brings tokens (designer, 2026-10-29).

choices.label: Strikes only
choices.description: Only the strikes' sway (the gathers) brings tokens (designer, 2026-10-29).

choices.label: Signatures only
choices.description: Only the signatures' sway brings tokens (designer, 2026-10-29).

choices.label: At nightfall
choices.description: An alternative (designer, 2026-10-30): no card brings tokens; instead, at the round's close, after the fights, every location where there was no fight gains 1 of its own faction's tokens per sway there (all players'), if it can (the supply has one, and the faction may enter there). Prototype: these arrive before growth, and a short supply fills locations in board order.

variants.label: A way back for factions
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-26), first draft: a suit card may be played to bring its faction back while it has no location with 2 or more of its tokens: up to the card's sway of its tokens at its suit locations or where it is, 1 standing with it each.

choices.label: On
choices.description: The first draft.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: No way back: a faction wiped out stays gone.

variants.label: Starting tokens
variants.description: SD1 (designer): how each faction's tokens start on its three aligned locations; 2 on each from 2026-10-21; 3 on each (even) by default since 2026-10-29 (designer, D32: more tokens on the board). Back to 2 on each (two) by default (designer, 2026-10-29, D33).

choices.label: 5, 1 and 1
choices.description: SD1 as first drafted: 5 on a random home location, 1 on each of the other two.

choices.label: 3 on each
choices.description: The first draft (designer, 2026-10-17): 3 on each of the three (45 in all).

choices.label: 2 on each
choices.description: SD1 (designer, 2026-10-21): 2 on each of the three (30 in all).

variants.label: Passing
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-28): a switch, not a decision; off by default (passing looked like a lazy way to wait for others). With passing off there is no passing: on your turn you play a card (for its action, for sway, or for no effect when it has nothing to target), the hard choice instead of waiting; a player whose hand is empty is skipped, and the round's play ends when every card has been played.

choices.label: On
choices.description: The first draft (TU1): play or pass; passing is not final.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: No passing: play a card each turn; the round ends when every card is played.

variants.label: Extra card sway
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-29): bump up sway values, to make more card actions payable (the game feel tuning, 1.7). Added to every strike's and shift's printed sway (a signature's sway stays your hand size, D24; unsuited cards have none). The amount is being measured. Designer (2026-10-29): stays as a switch at +0.

choices.description: The printed sway.
Strikes 3, shifts 4.
Strikes 4, shifts 5.

map.notes: Prototype board, layout D (the first draft's map; not a decision). Axial hex coordinates; directions E, NE, NW, W, SW, SE. Adjacent means hexes sharing a border. Mirror is the reflection across the lake.
